interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to provide safe and designated crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a furniture or planting zone to create a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time on this wide arterial.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central pedestrian refuge island to reduce exposure time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for a buffer or bike lane.

interventions.description: Reconfigure the four-lane road to two through lanes with a center turn lane and bike lanes to reduce speeds and provide a buffer.

interventions.title: Curb and Sidewalk Definition
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb to clearly delineate the pedestrian zone from the travel lanes and prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or bollards between the sidewalk and the road to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility lane markings to organize traffic flow and encourage safer driving behavior.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation/Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the wide driveway entrance to the parking lot to reduce the speed of turning vehicles and the exposure time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the existing cracked and uneven pavement with a smooth, ADA-compliant concrete surface to eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Use curbs and landscaping to define and narrow vehicle access points, reducing the width of the conflict zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway narrowing
